Retaining Ring · S/R Combined Type (Shaft)

C-type Retaining Ring for Shafts, S/R Combined (ISTW)

A C-type retaining ring mounted on the outside of a shaft; it is the shaft-side combined type that pairs with the hole-side IRTW. Compared with the standard S-type (for shafts), it has a smaller clearance outer diameter (d5), reducing interference with mating parts while still fitting directly into narrow spaces. The spec symbol is ISTW (丸S形止め輪), conforming to the KS B 1336 and JIS B 2804 standards.

Material · Hardness · Surface Treatment

The standard material is spring steel; spring-grade stainless steel is available as a made-to-order option. Hardness is HRC 44–52, and the standard surface treatment is phosphate coating (A.C.P).
